description_zh: 调用ModifyScalingConfiguration修改一个ECI类型的伸缩配置
name: ModifyEciScalingConfiguration

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling configuration to be modified
parameters.help_zh: 待修改伸缩配置的ID
parameters.name: scaling_configuration_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the scaling configuration. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, underscores (_), hyphens (-), or periods (.). It must start with a letter, digit, or Chinese character.

The name of a scaling configuration must be unique within a scaling group in a region. If you do not specify this parameter, the ID of the scaling configuration is used by default
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩配置的名称。长度为2~64个英文或中文字符，以数字、大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）、短划线（-）或半角句号（.）。

在同一地域下同一伸缩组内伸缩配置名称唯一。如果您没有指定该参数，则默认使用伸缩配置的ID
parameters.name: scaling_configuration_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the security group to which the ECI instance belongs. ECI instances in the same security group can access each other.

If you do not specify a security group, the system automatically uses the default security group in the region that you select. You must ensure that the inbound rules of the security group include the protocols and ports that the container needs to expose. If no default security group exists in the region, the system performs automatic creation of a default security group and adds the container protocols and ports that you declared to the inbound rules of the security group
parameters.help_zh:
ECI实例所属的安全组ID。同一个安全组内的ECI实例之间可以互相访问。

如果没有指定安全组，系统将自动使用您选择的地域下的默认安全组，您需要确保该安全组的入方向规则中包含容器需要暴露的协议和端口。如果您在该地域下没有默认安全组，系统将自动创建一个默认安全组，并将您声明的容器协议和端口添加到该安全组的入方向规则中
parameters.name: security_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the ECI instance, which is also the name of the container group. The format requirements are as follows:

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length.
The name can contain lowercase letters, digits, or hyphens (-). It cannot start or end with a hyphen (-)
parameters.help_zh:
ECI实例名称，即容器组名称。格式要求如下：

长度为2~128个字符。
支持英文小写字母、数字或者短划线（-），不能以短划线（-）开头或者结尾
parameters.name: container_group_name

parameters.help_en:

OnFailure: The instance restarts on failure.

Default value: Always

Never：从不重启。
OnFailure：失败时重启。

默认值：Always

Specifies whether to allocate a buffer for standard input in the container runtime. If this parameter is not set, a read from the standard input of the container results in EOF.

Default value: false
fields.help_zh:
此容器是否应在容器运行时为标准输入分配缓冲区。如果未设置，则容器中标准输入的读取值将导致EOF。

默认值：false
fields.name: stdin

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the standard input stream maintains the enabling status across multiple attached sessions when standard input is set to true.

If StdinOnce is set to true, the standard input is opened when the container starts, remains empty until the first client attaches to the standard input, and then stays open to accept data until the client disconnects. After the client disconnects, the standard input enters the shutdown state and remains in the shutdown state until the container is restarted
fields.help_zh:
当标准输入为true时，标准输入流将在多个附加会话中是否保持开启状态。

如果StdinOnce设为true，标准输入在容器开启时被打开，在首个客户端附加到标准输入之前都为空，然后会一直保持开启状态，接收数据，直到客户端连接断开，此时标准输入被关闭，在容器重启前一直保持关闭状态
fields.name: stdin_once

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to allocate a TTY. Default value: false.

Set this parameter to true when Command is set to `/bin/bash`
fields.help_zh:
是否开启交互。默认为false。

当Command为`/bin/bash`命令时，需要设置为true
fields.name: tty

fields.help_en:
The directory where the volume is mounted in the container.

<notice>The content in the mount directory of the container is directly overwritten by the content of the volume. Use this parameter with caution.
</notice>
fields.help_zh:

<notice>容器挂载目录下的内容会被Volume的内容直接覆盖，请您谨慎使用。
</notice>
fields.name: mount_path

fields.help_en:
The mount propagation settings for the volume. Mount propagation allows volumes mounted by a container to be shared with other containers in the same pod, or even with other pods on the same node. Valid values:

None: The volume does not receive any subsequent mounts that are executed on the volume or its subdirectories.
HostToCotainer: The volume receives all subsequent mounts that are executed on the volume or its subdirectories.
Bidirectional: Similar to HostToCotainer, the volume receives all subsequent mounts. Additionally, the volume is propagated back to the host and to all containers of all pods that use the same volume.

Default value: None

fields.help_en:
The mount propagation settings for the volume. Mount propagation allows volumes mounted by a container to be shared with other containers in the same pod, or even with other pods on the same node. Valid values:

None: The volume does not receive any subsequent mounts that are executed on the volume or its subdirectories.
HostToCotainer: The volume receives all subsequent mounts that are executed on the volume or its subdirectories.
Bidirectional: Similar to HostToCotainer, the volume receives all subsequent mounts. Additionally, the volume is propagated back to the host and to all containers of all pods that use the same volume.

Default value: None

Bidirectional：和HostToCotainer类似，能感知挂载操作。另外，该卷将被传播回主机和使用同一卷的所有Pod的所有容器。

parameters.help_en:
The instance family level. This parameter is used to filter instance types that meet the requirements and takes effect only when `CostOptimization` is enabled. Valid values:
EntryLevel: Entry-level, which refers to shared instance types. This level provides lower costs but cannot guarantee stable computing performance. It is suitable for scenarios with low CPU utilization. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/108489.html.
EnterpriseLevel: Enterprise-level. This level provides stable performance and dedicated resources, and is suitable for scenarios that require high stability. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25378.html.
CreditEntryLevel: Credit-based entry-level, which refers to burstable instances. This level ensures computing performance by using CPU credits and is suitable for scenarios with low CPU utilization but occasional CPU bursts. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/59977.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例规格族级别，用于筛选符合要求的实例规格范围，当`CostOptimization`开启时生效。取值范围：

EntryLevel：入门级，即共享型实例规格。成本更低，但是无法保证实例计算性能的稳定。适用于平时CPU使用率低的业务场景。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/108489.html。
EnterpriseLevel：企业级。性能稳定且资源独享，适用于对稳定性要求高的业务场景。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25378.html。
CreditEntryLevel：积分入门级，即突发性能实例。通过CPU积分来保证计算性能，适用于平时CPU使用率低、偶有突发CPU使用率的业务场景。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/59977.html
parameters.name: instance_family_level

parameters.help_en:
The control parameter for the update method of the Containers parameter. Valid values:

RenewUpdate: Full update. The Containers parameter in the request parameters prevails and overwrites the original Containers parameter configurations.
IncrementalUpdate: Incremental update. Containers are matched based on Containers.Name. Only the parameters specified in the request parameters are updated. Unspecified parameters are not updated.

Default value: RenewUpdate
parameters.help_zh:
Containers参数更新方式的控制参数。取值范围：

RenewUpdate：全量更新，以更新请求参数中Containers为准，覆盖原有Containers参数配置。
IncrementalUpdate：增量更新，根据Containers.Name进行Containers匹配，仅更新请求参数中已设置的参数，未设置的参数不进行更新。

默认值：RenewUpdate
parameters.name: containers_update_type

parameters.help_en:
The performance level of the cloud disk used for data caching. We recommend ESSDs. Valid values for ESSDs:

PL0: Up to 10,000 random read/write IOPS per disk.
PL1: Up to 50,000 random read/write IOPS per disk.
PL2: Up to 100,000 random read/write IOPS per disk.
PL3: Up to 1,000,000 random read/write IOPS per disk.

Default value: PL1.
For more information about ESSDs, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html
parameters.help_zh:
数据缓存使用的云盘的性能等级。建议优先使用ESSD云盘，该云盘的性能等级取值范围：

PL0：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 1万。
PL1：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 5万。
PL2：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 10万。
PL3：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 100万。

默认值：PL1。
关于ESSD云盘的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html
parameters.name: data_cache_pl

parameters.help_en:
The provisioned read/write IOPS of the ESSD AutoPL cloud disk used for data caching. Valid values: 0 to min{50000, 1000 × Capacity - Baseline performance}, where Baseline performance = min{1800 + 50 × Capacity, 50000}.

For more information about ESSD AutoPL cloud disks, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/368372.html
parameters.help_zh:
数据缓存使用ESSD AutoPL云盘时，ESSD AutoPL云盘预配置的读写IOPS。 取值范围：0~min{50000, 1000容量-基准性能}，其中，基准性能=min{1800+50容量, 50000}。

关于ESSD AutoPL云盘的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/368372.html
parameters.name: data_cache_provisioned_iops
